plan.title: Call Participants: participants, onJoin, onLeave, onSpeaking, raise/lower

narrative.Summary: Adds participant awareness to the Call interface — essential for group calls and meetings. An AI agent needs to know who is in the call, who just joined or left, and who is actively speaking (so it knows when to listen vs speak). Also adds raise()/lower() as meeting-specific signalling that a well-behaved agent should support. All items are defined in the Call interface with MockCall + MockVoiceProvider implementations and tests. Real provider implementations are stubs.
narrative.Acceptance: Call interface has: readonly participants: ReadonlyArray<Participant>; onJoin(cb); onLeave(cb); onSpeaking(cb); raise(): Promise<void>; lower(): Promise<void>. Participant type: { id, name?, endpoint, muted, hasVideo }. MockVoiceProvider gains: triggerJoin(callId, participant), triggerLeave(callId, participant), triggerSpeaking(callId, participant, isSpeaking). Tests: participants is empty initially; triggerJoin adds to list + fires onJoin; triggerLeave removes + fires onLeave; triggerSpeaking fires onSpeaking with correct args; raise()/lower() resolve. task check passes.

items.title: src/types.ts — add Participant type
items.narrative: Participant = { id: string; name?: string; endpoint: Endpoint; muted: boolean; hasVideo: boolean; }. Exported from src/index.ts. Represents a single party in a multi-participant call or meeting.

items.title: src/interfaces/call.ts — add participants, onJoin, onLeave, onSpeaking, raise, lower
items.narrative: readonly participants: ReadonlyArray<Participant> — current participant list (excludes self). onJoin(cb: (p: Participant) => void): void — fires when someone joins. onLeave(cb: (p: Participant, reason?: string) => void): void — fires when someone leaves. onSpeaking(cb: (p: Participant, isSpeaking: boolean) => void): void — fires when active speaker changes (VAD). raise(): Promise<void> — raise hand. lower(): Promise<void> — lower hand.

items.title: src/providers/mock/mock-call.ts — implement participants and events
items.narrative: _participants: Participant[] maintained internally. participants getter returns readonly view. onJoin/onLeave/onSpeaking register callbacks stored in callback arrays. raise()/lower() no-op Promises.

items.title: src/providers/mock/mock-voice-provider.ts — add participant simulation helpers
items.narrative: triggerJoin(callId, participant): adds to call's participants, fires onJoin. triggerLeave(callId, participantId, reason?): removes from list, fires onLeave. triggerSpeaking(callId, participantId, isSpeaking): fires onSpeaking. These mirror the existing speak()/setState() pattern for deterministic testing.

items.title: Tests: test/mock/call-participants.test.ts
items.narrative: Initial participants is empty. triggerJoin adds to list and fires callback. triggerLeave removes and fires callback. Multiple join events accumulate. triggerSpeaking fires with correct participant and boolean. raise()/lower() resolve without error. onJoin callback receives correct Participant shape.
